edges: Archaeologists have never been able to identify any remains of the Pharos.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Both Headlamps and The Pharos are monumental light houses built around the same time and serve as entrances to the port of Alexandria.
The Pharos was the entrance to Alexandria harbour for centuries.
The Headlamps lighthouse has been lighting the entrance to the Port of Alexandria for centuries.

edges: Archaeologists have never been able to positively identify any remains related to the Headlamps lighthouse.
